name: Niina Marian
source:
Niina is a homeroom teacher and popular with everyone, especially boys. She understands students and has a flexible way of thinking; she is a good adviser to troubled students. She also has a problem with stiff shoulders.

Mysteriously, when she is called "Marian-sensei," she goes crazy.
